notes: Hand-written synthetic repository written for receipts-bench. The reference README is the documentation deliverable; its R4 example prints values of the starting data/rates.json, which the M1 overlay replaces.

M1.explanation: The variant data/rates.json says the rate card is now published only through https://rates.logistics.internal, which the sandbox cannot reach, and lists no zones, so no example can show or run against the real rates.

M2.reason: The test queues a label with the labeld daemon over /run/labeld/spool.sock, which exists only on the warehouse hosts, so it fails for a reason outside the task.
